name: Winter Trophy Hold and Win

features.name: Medal Respin
features.description: A coin respin with a 5,000x jackpot.

review:
Winter Trophy Hold and Win is a winter-sports slot where a tiger, fox, hare and penguin compete in skiing, figure skating, snowboarding and curling, with Coach Bear as the wild. It plays on 25 lines.

Its Medal Respin feature works like Gold Respin, with a 5,000x jackpot for collecting enough coins, alongside free spins. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,624x maximum and a 96.14% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 182 spins. It's another take on the Grand Mustang and Royal High-Road design.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
